offering_description.value: Makes and sells spices, herbs, seasoning blends, condiments and sauces to grocery retailers, food manufacturers and restaurants. It also develops custom flavor systems for food manufacturers and foodservice operators, sourcing raw ingredients and blending and packaging them.

primary_products.value: spices and herbs; seasoning blends; condiments and sauces; hot sauces; flavor systems for food manufacturers

customer_segment.value: B2B: food manufacturers, restaurants, foodservice operators, grocery and mass retailers; B2C: individual households buying retail grocery products

revenue_model.value: product sales: spices, seasonings and condiments sold to retailers, food manufacturers and foodservice buyers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: buys raw spices and ingredients, processes and packages them, sold to retailers and food companies; brand owner: owns and markets its consumer brands, sold through grocery retailers; component supplier: supplies flavor blends and seasonings used as ingredients by food manufacturers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; brand owner; component supplier

geography_served.value: global: sold across the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: spices and herbs, seasonings, condiments and sauces, flavor solutions for food companies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large grocery chains and food manufacturers; distributors / dealers: foodservice distributors supplying restaurants and institutions; third-party retail: grocery stores, mass merchants and warehouse clubs; online: online grocery and e-commerce retailers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety, labeling and allergen rules from the FDA and USDA
